data.name: Musheera
data.gender_notes: Musheera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Musheera means 'the one who guides or helps'. It is derived from the verb shara'a, which means 'to open, to guide, or to show the way'. This name holds significant spiritual relevance in Islam as it reflects the guidance of Allah and the role of prophets and spiritual leaders in guiding believers. The name Musheera carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musheera usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
